:::{#thm-empty-set-unique}
#### There is only one empty set

If $E_1$ and $E_2$ are sets with no elements,
then $E_1 = E_2$.

:::

::: proof

Neither set has any elements,
so every element of $E_1$ is an element of $E_2$ and vice versa,
[vacuously](#def-vacuous-truth).
Sets with the same elements are equal (@def-set).

:::
